title: nozand smaller performance-related updates
body:
The nozand program has some pieces of code that can be bettered: 
- [ 1 ] Line 493:  Move Sm1[:, orbidx_uall, :] into a separate copy. Its constant over the propagation
- [ 2 ] Line 1081: allocate memory for the transpose operation
- [ 3 ] Some of the RK methods available are "first same as last" (FSAL), which means the last sub-step of the previous step can be copied to the first sub-step of the next step. ~20% performance improvement
- [ 4 ] PI controller for the stepsize. The current step-size controller is the simplest available, but it apparently be helpful to smooth over previous step-sizes and by doing this the amount of times the error exceeds the tolerance can be lessened.

title: Refactor TimedependentTransport.py into modular Python package
body:
**Summary**
The current `TimedependentTransport.py` file is extremely large (4800+ lines), mixing core transport calculations, fitting logic, I/O, plotting, numerical solvers, and helpers. This monolithic structure makes the code difficult to maintain, test, and extend.

**Proposal**
Refactor the codebase by splitting `TimedependentTransport.py` into focused, well-documented modules that reflect logical boundaries:

### Proposed Directory Structure
```
Zandpack/
├── core/
│   ├── transport.py         # Main TD_Transport class
│   └── constants.py         # Physical constants, config flags
├── io/
│   ├── readers.py           # File I/O (_READ_get_* functions)
│   └── writers.py           # Export, pickling
├── preprocessing/
│   ├── contour.py           # Make_Contour, pole analysis
│   └── initialization.py    # Device & electrode setup
├── fitting/
│   ├── lorentzian.py        # Fit, diagonalization, curve fitting
├── propagation/
│   ├── ode_solvers.py       # AdaptiveRK4, AdaptiveDOP, scipy_ode
│   └── equations.py         # EOM kernels
├── analysis/
│   ├── inspection.py        # Inspect_* methods
│   └── visualization.py     # Plotting, diagnostic
└── deprecated/              # Old/deprecated methods for archive
```
- Create `__init__.py` in each directory.
- Move each related method and its dependencies.
- Remove deprecated code and code graveyard after migration.
- Fix bug in `_READ_get_S` (should call `read_overlap()` not `read_hamiltonian()`).
- Replace `assert 1==0` with proper exceptions.
- Add missing type hints and docstrings.
- Split large methods and add unit tests per module.

**Benefits**
- Greatly improved code maintainability and navigation
- Easier unit testing and CI integration
- Enables independent module development and documentation
- Separates scientific logic from I/O and plotting

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Core logic, I/O, fitting, analysis, and ODE solvers are in separate modules
- All public classes/functions are documented
- Deprecated and unused code is removed or archived
- All tests still run after refactor

---
*Inspired by discussion in #issues and best practices for scientific Python*
